round_selection: Prefix rounds 0 through 0, inclusive, in every chunk, parent and root compression.
message_domain: Finite byte strings of bit length below 2^64.

relation.postcondition: The two complete blake3-r1 hashes agree on all 256 output bits.

out_of_scope: Changing rounds, IV, padding, mode or output length
selection_note: Organizer-selected exploration target; no first-unbroken boundary is asserted.
initialization: Standard BLAKE3 IV; unkeyed mode. No keyed hashing or key derivation.
padding: Blocks of at most 64 bytes, zero filled only for compression word loading; true block length encoded. Empty input is one empty chunk/block.
schedule: Standard eight G calls per round and BLAKE3 message permutation between rounds, retaining only the first r rounds.
feed_forward: Standard 16-word compression output: v[i] XOR v[i+8], then v[i+8] XOR input_cv[i], for i=0..7.
tree: Standard binary tree over 1024-byte chunks with 64-bit zero-based chunk counters. Largest power-of-two left subtree for non-power-of-two chunk counts. Parent CV=IV, block=left CV || right CV, length64, counter0, PARENT flag.
digest_encoding: First 32 little-endian root output bytes. Root compression uses output counter0 and ROOT together with chunk or parent flags; never hash an already finalized root CV.
